definitions.joy: A person in the described scene currently experiences positive pleasure, delight or happiness. A smile alone, politeness, absent distress, quoted vocabulary or a hypothetical feeling is insufficient.
definitions.sadness: A person in the described scene currently experiences sorrow, grief, dejection or felt disappointment. Bad circumstances alone, fatigue, anger, quoted vocabulary or a hypothetical feeling is insufficient.
definitions.sexual_desire: An explicitly adult person currently feels sexual attraction or wants consensual erotic intimacy with another explicitly adult person. Affection, companionship, aesthetic appreciation, biological terminology or discussion of desire alone is insufficient; no graphic acts are described.
definitions.confusion: A person currently struggles to make sense of information, reconcile interpretations or understand what is happening. Merely lacking a fact, choosing between understood options, disagreement, surprise or mentioning the word is insufficient.
definitions.green: A physical object or surface in the described scene is explicitly asserted to currently have green visible coloration, including ordinary shades of green. Names, printed words, environmental policies, metaphors, future colors and explicitly absent green objects are insufficient. This is a textual color assertion, not visual verification.
definitions.dog: At least one living domestic dog is physically present in the described scene. Breed names count when the scene identifies a living animal; dog words, pictures, statues, metaphors, other species, wishes and explicitly absent dogs do not. This is textual animal presence, not visual verification.

limitations: Authored synthetic labels require independent human review before strong external-validity claims.
No model responses or activation measurements are included; this dataset establishes no accuracy threshold.
Each split contains distinct scenario families, not alternate frames of the same context.
The intended scope is the asserted text-concept relation; imagery, tone and real-world truth are not verified.
Heldout examples must not be used for feature selection, threshold fitting or iterative prompt tuning.
